rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MEOK NIS2 DE Register assists German organizations with NIS2-UmsuCG compliance by validating regulatory scope and KRITIS classifications, generating BSI portal-ready registration packets, providing Section 30/32 reporting timelines, and producing HMAC-SHA256 signed compliance proofs. Available via PyPI and Docker, it automates the preparation process for BSI portal submission.
